title: Apartment Splitting Basis
body_html:
Apartment Splitting Basis

This is the shared foundation layer node for apartment splitting bases. It should be used by both epipelagic and supercuspidal nodes instead of the older epipelagic_theta.apartment_splitting_basis.

Fix a basis \[ \{e_i:i\in I^+\oplus I^-\oplus I^0\} \] adapted to the form: \(I^-=-I^+\), the \(e_i,e_{-i}\) form hyperbolic pairs, and \(I^0\) indexes anisotropic lines. A self-dual lattice function in the associated apartment is determined by real numbers \(a_i\) for \(i\in I^+\), with \[ a_{-i}=-a_i,\qquad a_i=\frac12\nu(\langle e_i,e_i\rangle) \quad(i\in I^0), \] and \[ L_r=\bigoplus_{i\in I} e_i\,p_D^{[(r-a_i)/\nu_D]}. \] The coordinates \(a_i\) identify the apartment with \(\mathbb R^n\).
